2608.04788.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
2608.04788.paper_summary: Large language model agents are commonly trained through reinforcement learning with sparse trajectory-level rewards, which offer limited guidance on how strongly individual tokens should be updated. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) addresses this by re-scoring generated tokens under a privileged replay view to obtain dense, token-level supervision. However, we identify a confounding issue: the resulting support may reflect both the privileged information contained in the replay view and score shifts induced by the replay scaffold, making it difficult to attribute the support specifically to that information. This issue is especially pronounced when future environment observations serve as privileged information, since replaying them requires reconstructing an extended scaffold that itself perturbs token scores. To resolve this confounding, we propose Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation (OCSD), which contrasts two structurally matched replay views, Full and Observation-Ablated, differing only in whether the actual future observation is present, to derive an observation residual that discounts score changes shared by the replay scaffold. OCSD then applies this residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates at high-uncertainty steps, while preserving the trajectory-level update direction. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across three Qwen3 model scales show that OCSD consistently outperforms strong baselines. Diagnostic analyses further confirm that the calibrated residual aligns better with local environment feedback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yiy1x/OCSD.
2608.04788.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理通常通過強化學習與稀疏的軌跡級獎勵進行訓練，這些獎勵對於個別標記應該如何更新提供了有限的指導。<lb/>在策略內自我蒸餾（OPSD）通過在特權重播視圖下重新評分生成的標記來解決這個問題，以獲得密集的標記級監督。<lb/>然而，我們發現了一個混淆問題：結果支持可能同時反映重播視圖中包含的特權信息和重播支架引起的分數變化，這使得難以將支持具體歸因於該信息。<lb/>當未來環境觀察作為特權信息時，這個問題尤其明顯，因為重播它們需要重建一個擴展的支架，而這本身會擾動標記分數。<lb/>為了解決這個混淆，我們提出了觀察校準自我蒸餾（OCSD），它對比了兩個結構上匹配的重播視圖，完整視圖和觀察消融視圖，僅在實際的未來觀察是否存在上有所不同，以推導出一個觀察殘差，該殘差折扣了重播支架共享的分數變化。<lb/>OCSD然後將這個殘差應用於在高不確定性步驟中調節標記級GRPO更新，同時保持軌跡級更新方向。<lb/>在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA的三個Qwen3模型規模上的實驗顯示，OCSD始終優於強基線。<lb/>診斷分析進一步確認，校準的殘差與當地環境反饋的對齊更好。<lb/>我們的代碼在https://github.com/yiy1x/OCSD上公開可用。
